candidates.statement: Postgres save_order spans fail with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size 5 and idle 0 across all sampled checkout traces, so order writes block until the gateway's read timeout and checkout returns 502.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or logs; pool exhaustion is inferred from idle=0 and DependencyUnavailable errors only.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s preceded by order-service ReadTimeout on POST /v1/orders, with postgres.save_order failing DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0/size=5 in every sampled request. Gateway metrics confirm /v1/checkout 502s and p95 ~2406ms. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
missing_evidence: Postgres connection pool saturation metrics (waiting clients, max connections) for the order service
Postgres server logs or error details for save_order failures during the incident window
